item.coloph: zhes mkha' 'gro'i snying thig zab gcod kyi gdams pa 'di ni mdo smad 'dra yul sbas rong rdo rjerdzong gi gnas spos ri ngad ldan nas mtsho rgyal rnam rol mkha' 'gro'i ming 'dzin bde chen chos kyi dbang mo'i gter gzhung ltar du dur khrod gzha' yas khang dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dngos su zhal mjal dbang thob cing brda' yig 'gags med shar ba gnang nas gter du drangs shing phyis su brda yig grub pa mngon du phyung te gsang gling pas brda' tshig ris su bkod cing / mchog sprul g.yung drung/ g.yung drung dpal ldan/ g.yung drung blo gsal/ bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal sogs la gnang ba'o//
